assertions.assertion: States that EF migrations are required even if not using SAML
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states migrations are required even for non-SAML deployments because the schema must match the v8 model.

assertions.assertion: Shows the migration command: dotnet ef migrations add Update_DuendeIdentityServer_v8_0
assertions.rationale: Shows the exact command dotnet ef migrations add Update_DuendeIdentityServer_v8_0 with the -c ConfigurationDbContext option.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that v8 adds SAML-related tables to the schema
assertions.rationale: Explains v8 added SAML-related tables to both the Configuration and Operational stores.

assertions.assertion: Includes dotnet ef database update or equivalent to apply the migration
assertions.rationale: Includes dotnet ef database update for both ConfigurationDbContext and PersistedGrantDbContext.
